description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the LDAPSyncService, specifically testing the creation of system users and their synchronization with LDAP entries in a Human Resource Management system. The class contains multiple test methods that validate different scenarios of LDAP user synchronization, such as handling existing users, updates, and mapping configurations.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceCreateSystemUsersTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for verifying LDAP synchronization functionality within the OrangeHRM platform, focusing on creating and updating system users based on LDAP entries and various configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including setting up mock services and fixture directory path.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsers
methods.description: Tests the creation of system users from LDAP entries when no pre-existing users are present.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithLocalUsers
methods.description: Tests synchronization when local pre-existing user data exists, verifying users are updated or added accordingly.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithEmployeeMapping
methods.description: Tests user creation with specific employee attribute mapping and verifies updates to employee records.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenUsernameChanged
methods.description: Tests handling of LDAP entries where username changes occur, ensuring old users are replaced or updated.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenFieldsNotChanged
methods.description: Verifies that no unnecessary updates are made to users when LDAP fields have not changed.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenFieldsChanged
methods.description: Verifies that user and employee records are updated when LDAP attributes change.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithNonUniqueEmployeeIdAndWorkEmail
methods.description: Tests the behavior when multiple LDAP entries have non-unique employee IDs or work emails, ensuring correct user creation and assignment.

methods.name: getLDAPUsers
methods.description: Utility method to generate a list of LDAPUser instances for testing, with customizable employee attribute mappings.
